notes: Account summary: Stratus Foothold is a federally-contracted critical infrastructure operator managing distributed control centers for regional utilities. Strong preference for private, air-gapped deployments; will not accept outbound network egress.
Primary use: operator assistant for incident triage + document search; offline summarization of shift logs; embeddings for historical event retrieval; reranking for alert prioritization.
Security posture: requires STIG-aligned baseline, FIPS-validated crypto, KMS/HSM integration with no internet key retrieval, chain-of-custody for model images, signed model images only.
Performance need: sub-200ms token latency on local LAN for chat ops at 8k context (burst to 30k during incident recon). Deterministic tail-latency critical for operator workflows.
Cost sensitivity: mid-to-high; will trade higher upfront HW/O&M for guaranteed deterministic latency and zero-cloud egress.
Model preferences: open-model family allowed if vetted and signed; prefer quantized 30B-70B variants for local inference; may evaluate Redwood-verified variants or customer-tuned checkpoint.

Deployment notes: air-gapped install (signed ISO/container), offline package updates via USB transfer with audit logs, ability to run on certified on-prem rack clusters (customer will supply hardware spec for ATO review).
Quote from CTO (on 2026-02-20 call): "No external egress — data classification prevents any outbound model or telemetry we don't explicitly approve."
Internal contact: Program Manager — Laura Hernandez (security lead) — primary technical reviewer for ATO and installation windows.
Procurement: tough timeline — must route through government purchasing office; finance expects POC approval in Q2 to include in FY27 budget submission.

POC plan (proposed): 6-week on-prem proof-of-concept. Week 1-2: environment prep, baseline performance. Week 3-4: use-case integration (embeddings + search, chat ops). Week 5: security validation + STIG checks. Week 6: handoff + runbook and remediation items.
Key legal items: export control questionnaire pending; need Redwood indemnity language for model IP in offline deployments.
Notes on telemetry: customer currently allows only aggregated, anonymized resource metrics via signed manifests; requires opt-in for any additional telemetry.
